headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 reaches 97.71% matched code
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 94.59% to 97.71%, with 5,053 of 5,124 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. New C implementations and classification of original handwritten assembly both contribute to the totals.
highlights: #93 reproduces three library routines with their original assemblers, while #94 separates the debug menu from a linker remnant.
#96 brings native-port argument fixes and functional C back into the decompilation.
#101 adds classification for original assembly in level code, rather than treating it as unfinished C.
#102 implements the space-flight engine-trail ribbon builder.
#104 adds functional C for 45 handwritten routines, with 35 checked against the original. This earns no extra matching credit.
#105 asks whether a compiler barrier is acceptable for a pause routine. #106's elevator-spawn match is still unmerged.
